title: Authority boundaries: event, policy, posting and evidence
summary: The preferred integration path is authoritative AccountingEvent -> effective legal-entity AccountingPolicy -> validated AccountingJournalDraft -> immutable AccountingBook entry. The core validates identities, period/chart/currency mechanics and evidence binding; it does not decide the legal or economic substance of the source event.
invariants: Operational systems do not normally post journals directly; they emit normalized AccountingEvent evidence.
The accounting engine checks legalEntityId and source replay/conflict before policy execution.
AccountingPolicy has both a semantic policyRef and immutable policyIdentity; the resulting journal retains both.
An accepted policy draft must remain bound to the source event, event fingerprint, correlation, counterparty, source authority and evidence refs.
Exact replay returns DUPLICATE before policy dispatch; changed reuse of a source identity is SOURCE_EVENT_CONFLICT.
Lower-level direct posting remains for controlled accountant/manual/migration workflows but is not silently adopted as event-transaction truth later.

provenance.claim: Operational event, policy identity, proposal binding, replay and company-isolation authority boundaries.
